title: Part 3 — Writing
writingModel:
— TASK 1: EMAIL TO A FRIEND —

Hi Aigerim!

How are you? I hope you are well. I am writing to tell you about my plans for the summer — there is a lot of exciting news!

First, I am going to do a six-week internship at a tech company in Astana. I applied for it in March and they offered me a place last week. I cannot believe it! After the internship, I am going to spend two weeks in Aktau with my family. My mum is going to cook every day and we are going to visit the beach together.

In August, I am going to start an intensive English course to improve my speaking skills. I think it will really help me in my future career.

I hope we are going to meet before September! Are you going to be in Almaty in August?

Best wishes,
Samal

— TASK 2: DESCRIBE YOUR PERFECT PLACE TO STUDY —

My favourite place to study is the WKU library. It is in the main building, on the second floor. The library is large, quiet, and very comfortable — much more comfortable than my dormitory room.

The library has big windows, so there is plenty of natural light. The chairs are soft and the desks are wide. It is the most peaceful place on the whole campus. There is a small café next to the main reading room, which is very convenient when I need a coffee during a long study session.

The library is open from eight in the morning until ten at night. I usually go there on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. I find it much easier to concentrate there than anywhere else.

Overall, I think the library is the perfect place to study because it is quiet, comfortable, and well-equipped. I am going to spend even more time there next semester.
